items.title: Jones Hank — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I didn't meet Barry Harris at that time.

ctx.x: Do you have any connection with him?

No; not really. I just met him one of the times I was in Detroit. I met Tommy Flanagan there. But, Tommy was a Detroiter. I guess that's where I met him. I didn't meet Barry Harris at that time. But, Barry Harris is Detroiter as well.

items.title: Barry Harris — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Really interesting too because when we got to the performance, Hank Jones and I, we went, we’re getting ready.

ctx.x: Who was it? Hank Jones, Oscar Peterson, and myself. We were for the Grammys, of course they wouldn’t put us on the big Grammys show. The put us in this little theatre where I happen to go by and see the theatre ahead of time and they said, “Boxing every Thursday.” [laughs] I said, “Shit.” Really interesting too because when we got to the performance, Hank Jones and I, we went, we’re getting ready. Some cat said, “Well, look, one of you can dress in the men’s room, one can dress in the ladies room.” [laughs] This…
